pending.title: #TSLA HOLIDAY REBOUND: CAN TESLA BREAK THROUGH $394.57? #Tesla #daytrading
pending.description:
Please ❤️like and 🔁share with fellow Tesla traders/investors

After closing Wednesday at $380.14, #TSLA is rebounding to $388 during today's shortened holiday trading session.

Holding above $370.68 keeps $394.57 within reach. A daily close above that resistance could set up a test of $413.15 as early as Monday or Tuesday.

Longer term, we remain bearish below $413.15, although #Tesla could continue trading between the mid-$340s and low-$420s throughout December.

A close above $422.97, however, would completely reverse our bearish outlook heading into 2027.

*
